server.title: Multifunctional Server
server.description: Self-hosted Ubuntu server running containerized services with security hardening, remote access via VPN and fully automated maintenance.

highlights.title: Automation
highlights.desc: Automated Docker container updates and Ubuntu unattended upgrades keep all services patched without manual intervention.

website.title: Portfolio
website.description: Portfolio built with Next.js, TypeScript and Material UI. Supports French/English localization, dark/light mode and is deployed via Docker with a GitLab CI/CD pipeline. This portfolio is itself a demonstration of my front-end and DevOps skills.

highlights.title: Stack
highlights.desc: Next.js 16, TypeScript, React, MUI, Tailwind, Docker, GitLab CI/CD.

highlights.title: Projects showcase
highlights.desc: Each project is presented with a description, screenshots and the technologies used, in an interactive scroll experience.

highlights.title: UX & animations
highlights.desc: Scroll-triggered animations, glass morphism UI, smooth transitions and responsive layout.

highlights.title: Performance & SEO
highlights.desc: Server-side rendering, IndexNow indexing, secure contact form with server-side validation.

highlights.title: i18n
highlights.desc: Full French and English support via next-intl, with locale-aware routing.

gaming.title: Video Game
gaming.description: Team project built with Unity and C#. Players design their own 3D city and explore it in first-person, with Spider-Man-inspired movement mechanics.

highlights.title: City builder
highlights.desc: Intuitive 3D object placement interface to build and customize a city.

highlights.title: Unity UI menu
highlights.desc: Ergonomic build menu with smooth navigation using Unity UI.

highlights.title: Camera systems
highlights.desc: Orthogonal, free and FPS cameras for a seamless transition between build and explore modes.

highlights.title: Movement mechanics
highlights.desc: Sprint, jump, wallrun and web-swinging powered by Unity Physics.

ai.title: Giant Tic-Tac-Toe AI
ai.description: University project: an AI agent playing Giant Tic-Tac-Toe — a nested 3×3 board where each move constrains the opponent's next play zone.

highlights.title: Minimax & Alpha-Beta pruning
highlights.desc: Efficiently searches a very large state space to choose the best move.

highlights.title: Heuristic evaluation
highlights.desc: Custom evaluation function that prioritizes winning moves.

highlights.title: Move generation
highlights.desc: Generates valid moves while respecting the board's nested constraints.

highlights.title: Network play
highlights.desc: Network interface to compete against other agents on a game server.

earth.title: Earth Globe
earth.description: Interactive 3D globe built with Next.js and CesiumJS, featuring city search, custom self-hosted map tiles, atmospheric controls and a space skybox.

highlights.title: 3D Globe
highlights.desc: CesiumJS renders a real-time interactive Earth with satellite imagery, 3D terrain and a physically-based atmosphere.

highlights.title: City Search
highlights.desc: Self-hosted Nominatim geocoder lets users search and fly to any city or location worldwide.

highlights.title: Custom Map Styles
highlights.desc: Self-hosted TileServer-GL serves multiple tile styles switchable at runtime.

highlights.title: Skybox & Atmosphere
highlights.desc: 6-face space skybox with tunable atmospheric parameters for a realistic space environment.
